event.kiel-partial-breakout.message: A detachment has escaped through the service gate. The rest are still coming over the wall, and the guards are firing on them.
event.kiel-prison-alarm.message: Alarm at the detention compound! The crowd has reached the gate and the guards are firing into it. If we do not break through now, the column will be scattered and the cells will stay shut.
event.kiel-prisoners-rescued.message: The gates are open. The surviving sailors seize rifles and join the uprising.
reinforce.2.message: The workers of Kiel stand with your uprising! Reinforcements have arrived.
